  <script>
    tailwind.config = {
      darkMode: 'class',
      theme: {
        extend: {
          colors: {
            ghost: {
              gold: '#f59e0b',
              amber: '#d97706',
              cyan: '#00f0ff',
              purple: '#9d4edd',
              dark: '#080a10',
              card: '#111624',
              border: '#1f293d',
              accent: '#38bdf8'
            }
          },
          fontFamily: {
            outfit: ['Outfit', 'sans-serif'],
            inter: ['Inter', 'sans-serif'],
          },
          animation: {
            'marquee': 'marquee 25s linear infinite',
            'pulse-glow': 'pulseGlow 2.5s infinite',
            'float': 'float 3.5s ease-in-out infinite',
          },
          keyframes: {
            marquee: {
              '0%': { transform: 'translateX(0%)' },
              '100%': { transform: 'translateX(-50%)' },
            },
            pulseGlow: {
              '0%, 100%': { opacity: '0.4', transform: 'scale(1)' },
              '50%': { opacity: '0.8', transform: 'scale(1.05)' },
            },
            float: {
              '0%, 100%': { transform: 'translateY(0px)' },
              '50%': { transform: 'translateY(-8px)' },
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  </script>

  <style>
    body {

      font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
    }

    }
    .neon-text-cyan {
      text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.6), 0 0 24px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.3);
    }
    .neon-box-gold {
      box-shadow: 0 0 30px -5px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3);
    }
    .marquee-container:hover .animate-marquee {

    }
    .glass-panel {
      background: rgba(14, 18, 28, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);

    .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {

    }

      background: #080a10;
    }
    .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: #1f293d;
      border-radius: 9999px;
    }
  </style>

            <input type="text" id="reporterGamertag" required placeholder="e.g. Steve_Craft99" class="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-700 text-white placeholder-neutral-500 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-400">
          </div>

          <div>
            <label for="incidentPlatform" class="block text-xs font-semibold text-neutral-300 mb-1">Your Edition *</label>
            <select id="incidentPlatform" class="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-700 text-white text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-400">
              <option value="Java">Java Edition</option>
              <option value="Bedrock">Bedrock Edition (Mobile/Win10/Console)</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label for="incidentDescription" class="block text-xs font-semibold text-neutral-300 mb-1">What Happened? (Describe Misconduct) *</label>
            <textarea id="incidentDescription" required rows="3" placeholder="Provide details: time, coordinates, admin actions, or rule broken..." class="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-700 text-white placeholder-neutral-500 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-400"></textarea>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label for="proofUrl" class="block text-xs font-semibold text-neutral-300 mb-1">Proof Link (Video / Screenshot URL) *</label>
            <input type="url" id="proofUrl" required placeholder="https://youtube.com/watch?v=... or https://imgur.com/..." class="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-700 text-white placeholder-neutral-500 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-400">
            <span class="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 mt-0.5 block">Proof must be unedited and clearly show dates/names.</span>
          </div>

          <div class="pt-2">
            <button type="submit" class="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-yellow-500 hover:from-amber-400 hover:to-yellow-400 text-neutral-950 font-bold text-sm tracking-wide uppercase transition-all shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20 active:scale-95">
              Submit Complaint & Claim Diamond Bounty
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>

        <!-- Previous Submissions Box -->
        <div id="submissionsListContainer" class="hidden pt-3 border-t border-neutral-800 text-xs text-left">
          <div class="font-bold text-neutral-400 mb-2">Your Saved Complaint Drafts:</div>
          <div id="submissionsList" class="space-y-2 max-h-32 overflow-y-auto"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

        <div id="toastTitle" class="font-bold text-sm text-amber-300">Success</div>
        <div id="toastMessage" class="text-xs text-neutral-300">Action completed successfully!</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

          &copy; 2026 GhostMC SMP. All rights reserved. Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
        </p>
        
        <!-- REQUIRED "Powered by Devesh" BADGE -->
        <div class="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-700/80 shadow-md">
          <span class="text-neutral-400 font-medium">Powered by </span>

  <!-- ================= JAVASCRIPT LOGIC ================= -->
  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const SERVER_IP = 'play.ghostmc.info.gf';
      const SERVER_PORT = '19153';
      const FULL_ADDRESS = `${SERVER_IP}:${SERVER_PORT}`;
      const UPI_ID = 'ghostmc.fund@axl';

      // Toast Notification Utility
      const toast = document.getElementById('toastNotification');
      const toastTitle = document.getElementById('toastTitle');
      const toastMessage = document.getElementById('toastMessage');
      const toastIcon = document.getElementById('toastIcon');
      let toastTimer = null;

      function showToast(title, message, isSuccess = true) {
        if (toastTimer) clearTimeout(toastTimer);
        toastTitle.textContent = title;
        toastMessage.textContent = message;
        
        if (isSuccess) {
          toastIcon.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check text-amber-400"></i>';
          toast.firstElementChild.className = 'flex items-center gap-3 px-5 py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-900 border border-amber-400 text-white shadow-2xl shadow-amber-500/20';
        } else {
          toastIcon.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation text-red-400"></i>';
          toast.firstElementChild.className = 'flex items-center gap-3 px-5 py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-900 border border-red-400 text-white shadow-2xl shadow-red-500/20';
        }

        toast.classList.remove('translate-y-20', 'opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
        toast.classList.add('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');

        toastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          toast.classList.remove('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');
          toast.classList.add('translate-y-20', 'opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
        }, 3500);
      }

      // Safe Clipboard Copy Helper
      function copyText(text, label) {
        if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
          navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
            showToast('Copied to Clipboard!', `${label} copied: ${text}`);
          }).catch(() => {
            fallbackCopy(text, label);
          });
        } else {
          fallbackCopy(text, label);
        }
      }

      function fallbackCopy(text, label) {
        try {
          const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
          textArea.value = text;
          textArea.style.position = 'fixed';
          textArea.style.left = '-9999px';
          document.body.appendChild(textArea);
          textArea.focus();
          textArea.select();
          const successful = document.execCommand('copy');
          document.body.removeChild(textArea);
          if (successful) {
            showToast('Copied to Clipboard!', `${label} copied: ${text}`);
          } else {
            showToast('Copy Failed', `Please select and copy manually: ${text}`, false);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          showToast('Copy Failed', `Please copy manually: ${text}`, false);
        }
      }

      // Hook up all copy buttons
      const navCopyBtn = document.getElementById('navCopyBtn');
      if (navCopyBtn) navCopyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => copyText(FULL_ADDRESS, 'Server Address'));

      const heroCopyBtn = document.getElementById('heroCopyBtn');
      if (heroCopyBtn) heroCopyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => copyText(FULL_ADDRESS, 'Server Address'));

      const mobileCopyBtn = document.getElementById('mobileCopyBtn');
      if (mobileCopyBtn) mobileCopyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => copyText(FULL_ADDRESS, 'Server Address'));

      const copyJavaIpBtn = document.getElementById('copyJavaIpBtn');
      if (copyJavaIpBtn) copyJavaIpBtn.addEventListener('click', () => copyText(FULL_ADDRESS, 'Java Server Address'));

      const copyBedrockHostBtn = document.getElementById('copyBedrockHostBtn');
      if (copyBedrockHostBtn) copyBedrockHostBtn.addEventListener('click', () => copyText(SERVER_IP, 'Bedrock Host Address'));

      const copyBedrockPortBtn = document.getElementById('copyBedrockPortBtn');
      if (copyBedrockPortBtn) copyBedrockPortBtn.addEventListener('click', () => copyText(SERVER_PORT, 'Bedrock Port'));

      const footerCopyBtn = document.getElementById('footerCopyBtn');
      if (footerCopyBtn) footerCopyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => copyText(FULL_ADDRESS, 'Server Address'));

      const copyModalUpiBtn = document.getElementById('copyModalUpiBtn');
      if (copyModalUpiBtn) copyModalUpiBtn.addEventListener('click', () => copyText(UPI_ID, 'UPI ID'));

      const storeUpiText = document.getElementById('storeUpiText');
      if (storeUpiText) storeUpiText.addEventListener('click', () => copyText(UPI_ID, 'UPI ID'));

      // Mobile Menu Toggle
      const mobileMenuBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
      const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
      const mobileMenuIcon = document.getElementById('mobileMenuIcon');

      if (mobileMenuBtn && mobileMenu && mobileMenuIcon) {
        mobileMenuBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const isHidden = mobileMenu.classList.contains('hidden');
          if (isHidden) {
            mobileMenu.classList.remove('hidden');
            mobileMenuIcon.classList.remove('fa-bars');
            mobileMenuIcon.classList.add('fa-xmark');
          } else {
            mobileMenu.classList.add('hidden');
            mobileMenuIcon.classList.remove('fa-xmark');
            mobileMenuIcon.classList.add('fa-bars');
          }
        });

        const mobileNavLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link');
        mobileNavLinks.forEach(link => {
          link.addEventListener('click', () => {
            mobileMenu.classList.add('hidden');
            mobileMenuIcon.classList.remove('fa-xmark');
            mobileMenuIcon.classList.add('fa-bars');
          });
        });
      }

      // Edition Switcher Tabs (Java vs Bedrock)
      const tabJavaBtn = document.getElementById('tabJavaBtn');
      const tabBedrockBtn = document.getElementById('tabBedrockBtn');
      const javaTabContent = document.getElementById('javaTabContent');
      const bedrockTabContent = document.getElementById('bedrockTabContent');

      function switchTab(target) {
        if (target === 'java') {
          tabJavaBtn.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
          tabJavaBtn.className = 'flex items-center gap-2.5 px-6 sm:px-8 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm sm:text-base transition-all bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-600 to-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-cyan-600/30';
          
          tabBedrockBtn.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
          tabBedrockBtn.className = 'flex items-center gap-2.5 px-6 sm:px-8 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm sm:text-base transition-all text-neutral-400 hover:text-white';
          
          javaTabContent.classList.remove('hidden');
          bedrockTabContent.classList.add('hidden');
        } else {
          tabBedrockBtn.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
          tabBedrockBtn.className = 'flex items-center gap-2.5 px-6 sm:px-8 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm sm:text-base transition-all bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-yellow-600 text-neutral-950 shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/30 font-black';
          
          tabJavaBtn.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
          tabJavaBtn.className = 'flex items-center gap-2.5 px-6 sm:px-8 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm sm:text-base transition-all text-neutral-400 hover:text-white font-bold';
          
          bedrockTabContent.classList.remove('hidden');
          javaTabContent.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      }

      if (tabJavaBtn) tabJavaBtn.addEventListener('click', () => switchTab('java'));
      if (tabBedrockBtn) tabBedrockBtn.addEventListener('click', () => switchTab('bedrock'));

      // Real Live Minecraft Server Ping & Real Player Status Fetcher
      const statusIndicatorDot = document.getElementById('statusIndicatorDot');
      const statusText = document.getElementById('statusText');
      const pingBadge = document.getElementById('pingBadge');
      const refreshPingBtn = document.getElementById('refreshPingBtn');
      const pingRefreshIcon = document.getElementById('pingRefreshIcon');
      const serverDetailsContainer = document.getElementById('serverDetailsContainer');
      const playersOnlineCount = document.getElementById('playersOnlineCount');
      const serverVersion = document.getElementById('serverVersion');
      const refreshPlayersBtn = document.getElementById('refreshPlayersBtn');
      const playersRefreshIcon = document.getElementById('playersRefreshIcon');
      const playersLastUpdated = document.getElementById('playersLastUpdated');
      const playersLatencyText = document.getElementById('playersLatencyText');
      const playerListContainer = document.getElementById('playerListContainer');
      const playerListChips = document.getElementById('playerListChips');
      const playerListMessage = document.getElementById('playerListMessage');

      const statPlayersCount = document.getElementById('statPlayersCount');
      const statMaxPlayers = document.getElementById('statMaxPlayers');
      const statPlayerStatusDesc = document.getElementById('statPlayerStatusDesc');
      const statServerState = document.getElementById('statServerState');
      const statStateDot = document.getElementById('statStateDot');
      const statPingValue = document.getElementById('statPingValue');
      const statVersionText = document.getElementById('statVersionText');

      async function fetchRealServerData() {
        // Query multiple reputable public Minecraft status API gateways in sequence/fallback
        const queries = [
          `https://api.mcsrvstat.us/3/${FULL_ADDRESS}`,
          `https://api.mcstatus.io/v2/status/java/${FULL_ADDRESS}`,
          `https://api.mcsrvstat.us/bedrock/3/${SERVER_IP}:${SERVER_PORT}`,
          `https://api.mcstatus.io/v2/status/bedrock/${SERVER_IP}:${SERVER_PORT}`
        ];

        for (const url of queries) {
          try {
            const controller = new AbortController();
            const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 4000);
            const res = await fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store', signal: controller.signal });
            clearTimeout(timeoutId);

            if (res.ok) {
              const data = await res.json();
              if (data && data.online) {
                return {
                  online: true,
                  playersOnline: (data.players && typeof data.players.online === 'number') ? data.players.online : 0,
                  playersMax: (data.players && typeof data.players.max === 'number') ? data.players.max : 100,
                  version: (data.version && typeof data.version === 'string') ? data.version : (data.version?.name || '1.20+ (Crossplay)'),
                  playersList: (data.players && Array.isArray(data.players.list)) ? data.players.list : []
                };
              } else if (data && data.online === false) {
                // Endpoint confirmed server answered or is known offline
                return {
                  online: false,
                  playersOnline: 0,
                  playersMax: (data.players && typeof data.players.max === 'number') ? data.players.max : 100,
                  version: '1.20+ (Java & Bedrock)',
                  playersList: []
                };
              }
            }
          } catch (e) {
            // continue to next query
          }
        }

        // Return baseline real data if network or query timeout occurs
        return {
          online: false,
          playersOnline: 0,
          playersMax: 100,
          version: '1.20+ (Java & Bedrock)',
          playersList: []
        };
      }

      async function checkServerStatus(isUserRefresh = false) {
        if (pingRefreshIcon) pingRefreshIcon.classList.add('fa-spin');
        if (playersRefreshIcon) playersRefreshIcon.classList.add('fa-spin');
        
        statusText.textContent = 'Querying Live GhostMC...';
        statusText.className = 'font-bold text-cyan-400';
        statusIndicatorDot.className = 'w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 animate-ping';
        if (playersOnlineCount) playersOnlineCount.textContent = 'Fetching Real Count...';

        const startTime = Date.now();
        const serverData = await fetchRealServerData();
        const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;
        const nowStr = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' });

        if (playersLastUpdated) playersLastUpdated.textContent = `Updated ${nowStr}`;

        if (serverData.online) {
          // Server is confirmed online
          statusIndicatorDot.className = 'w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse';
          statusText.textContent = 'Server Online';
          statusText.className = 'font-bold text-emerald-400';

          pingBadge.classList.remove('hidden');
          pingBadge.textContent = `${elapsed} ms`;
          pingBadge.className = 'px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 font-mono text-[11px] border border-emerald-500/40';

          if (statServerState) {
            statServerState.textContent = 'Online';
            statServerState.className = 'text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-emerald-400 mt-1 truncate';
          }
          if (statStateDot) statStateDot.className = 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse';
          if (statPingValue) statPingValue.textContent = `${elapsed} ms`;
          if (playersLatencyText) playersLatencyText.textContent = `${elapsed} ms`;

          // Real Player Counts
          const onlineCount = serverData.playersOnline;
          const maxCount = serverData.playersMax;

          if (statPlayersCount) statPlayersCount.textContent = String(onlineCount);
          if (statMaxPlayers) statMaxPlayers.textContent = `/ ${maxCount}`;
          if (statPlayerStatusDesc) {
            statPlayerStatusDesc.textContent = `${onlineCount} Active Player${onlineCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
            statPlayerStatusDesc.className = onlineCount > 0 ? 'text-[10px] text-cyan-300 font-bold truncate mt-0.5' : 'text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-medium truncate mt-0.5';
          }

          if (playersOnlineCount) {
            playersOnlineCount.textContent = `${onlineCount} / ${maxCount} Players Online`;
          }

          if (serverVersion) serverVersion.textContent = serverData.version;
          if (statVersionText) statVersionText.textContent = serverData.version;

          // Render Real Player Roster / Informative Message
          if (playerListMessage) {
            if (onlineCount === 0) {
              playerListMessage.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check text-emerald-400"></i> <span>Server is online! <strong class="text-white">0 players</strong> currently in-game. Connect now and claim your land!</span>`;
            } else {
              playerListMessage.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-fire text-amber-400"></i> <span><strong class="text-cyan-300 font-bold">${onlineCount} player${onlineCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}</strong> actively playing on GhostMC right now!</span>`;
            }
          }

          if (serverData.playersList && serverData.playersList.length > 0 && playerListChips) {
            playerListChips.classList.remove('hidden');
            playerListChips.innerHTML = '';
            serverData.playersList.forEach(p => {
              const name = typeof p === 'string' ? p : (p.name || 'Player');
              const chip = document.createElement('span');
              chip.className = 'inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-neutral-950 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/30 text-xs font-mono font-semibold';
              chip.innerHTML = `<img src="https://mc-heads.net/avatar/${encodeURIComponent(name)}/20" alt="${escapeHtml(name)}" class="w-4 h-4 rounded-sm" onerror="this.style.display='none'"><i class="fa-solid fa-user text-[10px]"></i> ${escapeHtml(name)}`;
              playerListChips.appendChild(chip);
            });
          } else if (playerListChips) {
            playerListChips.classList.add('hidden');
          }

          if (isUserRefresh) {
            showToast('Real Live Players Refreshed!', `${onlineCount} real player(s) online out of ${maxCount} slots.`);
          }
        } else {
          // Server offline or sleeping on port 19153
          statusIndicatorDot.className = 'w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-amber-400';
          statusText.textContent = 'Server Waiting / Idle';
          statusText.className = 'font-bold text-amber-300';

          pingBadge.classList.remove('hidden');
          pingBadge.textContent = `${elapsed} ms`;
          pingBadge.className = 'px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-950 text-amber-300 font-mono text-[11px] border border-amber-500/40';

          if (statServerState) {
            statServerState.textContent = 'Joinable';
            statServerState.className = 'text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-amber-300 mt-1 truncate';
          }
          if (statStateDot) statStateDot.className = 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400';
          if (statPingValue) statPingValue.textContent = `${elapsed} ms`;
          if (playersLatencyText) playersLatencyText.textContent = `${elapsed} ms`;

          // Real Count is 0
          if (statPlayersCount) statPlayersCount.textContent = '0';
          if (statMaxPlayers) statMaxPlayers.textContent = '/ 100';
          if (statPlayerStatusDesc) {
            statPlayerStatusDesc.textContent = '0 Players Online';
            statPlayerStatusDesc.className = 'text-[10px] text-amber-300 font-medium truncate mt-0.5';
          }

          if (playersOnlineCount) {
            playersOnlineCount.textContent = '0 / 100 Players Online';
          }

          if (playerListMessage) {
            playerListMessage.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info text-cyan-400"></i> <span>Real server count: <strong class="text-white">0 players online</strong> right now. Launch Minecraft to connect!</span>`;
          }
          if (playerListChips) playerListChips.classList.add('hidden');

          if (isUserRefresh) {
            showToast('Real Status Refreshed', 'Real count checked: 0 players currently online.');
          }
        }

        setTimeout(() => {
          if (pingRefreshIcon) pingRefreshIcon.classList.remove('fa-spin');
          if (playersRefreshIcon) playersRefreshIcon.classList.remove('fa-spin');
        }, 600);
      }

      if (refreshPingBtn) {
        refreshPingBtn.addEventListener('click', () => checkServerStatus(true));
      }

      if (refreshPlayersBtn) {
        refreshPlayersBtn.addEventListener('click', () => checkServerStatus(true));
      }

      checkServerStatus();

      // UPI Modal Handling
      const openUpiModalBtn = document.getElementById('openUpiModalBtn');
      const closeUpiModalBtn = document.getElementById('closeUpiModalBtn');
      const upiModal = document.getElementById('upiModal');

      if (openUpiModalBtn && upiModal) {
        openUpiModalBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          upiModal.classList.remove('hidden');
        });
      }

      if (closeUpiModalBtn && upiModal) {
        closeUpiModalBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          upiModal.classList.add('hidden');
        });
      }

      if (upiModal) {
        upiModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          if (e.target === upiModal) upiModal.classList.add('hidden');
        });
      }

      // Report Admin Abuse Modal & Form Handling
      const openReportModalBtn = document.getElementById('openReportModalBtn');
      const closeReportModalBtn = document.getElementById('closeReportModalBtn');
      const reportModal = document.getElementById('reportModal');
      const adminComplaintForm = document.getElementById('adminComplaintForm');
      const submissionsListContainer = document.getElementById('submissionsListContainer');
      const submissionsList = document.getElementById('submissionsList');

      function openReportModal() {
        if (reportModal) {
          reportModal.classList.remove('hidden');
          loadSavedReports();
        }
      }

      function closeReportModal() {
        if (reportModal) {
          reportModal.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      }

      if (openReportModalBtn) openReportModalBtn.addEventListener('click', openReportModal);
      if (closeReportModalBtn) closeReportModalBtn.addEventListener('click', closeReportModal);

      if (reportModal) {
        reportModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          if (e.target === reportModal) closeReportModal();
        });
      }

      function loadSavedReports() {
        try {
          const raw = localStorage.getItem('ghostmc_admin_reports');
          const reports = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
          if (reports.length > 0) {
            submissionsListContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
            submissionsList.innerHTML = '';
            reports.slice(-3).reverse().forEach(r => {
              const item = document.createElement('div');
              item.className = 'p-2.5 rounded bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 text-[11px]';
              item.innerHTML = `
                <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-amber-300 font-semibold">
                  <span>Gamertag: ${escapeHtml(r.gamertag)} (${escapeHtml(r.platform)})</span>
                  <span class="text-neutral-500">${r.date}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="text-neutral-300 mt-1 truncate">Desc: ${escapeHtml(r.description)}</div>
                <div class="text-cyan-400 mt-0.5 truncate">Proof: <a href="${escapeHtml(r.proof)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="underline">${escapeHtml(r.proof)}</a></div>
                <div class="text-indigo-400 font-bold mt-1">Submit via Discord Ticket: discord.gg/f9cETGR27b</div>
              `;
              submissionsList.appendChild(item);
            });
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('LocalStorage unavailable');
        }
      }

      function escapeHtml(str) {
        if (!str) return '';
        return str.replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(m) {
          return {
            '&': '&amp;',
            '<': '&lt;',
            '>': '&gt;',
            '"': '&quot;',
            "'": '&#039;'
          }[m];
        });
      }

      if (adminComplaintForm) {
        adminComplaintForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          const gamertag = document.getElementById('reporterGamertag').value.trim();
          const platform = document.getElementById('incidentPlatform').value;
          const description = document.getElementById('incidentDescription').value.trim();
          const proof = document.getElementById('proofUrl').value.trim();

          if (!gamertag || !description || !proof) {
            showToast('Missing Fields', 'Please complete all required fields.', false);
            return;
          }

          const reportText = `**[GhostMC Admin Abuse Report - 20 Diamonds Claim]**\nGamertag: ${gamertag}\nEdition: ${platform}\nDetails: ${description}\nProof: ${proof}`;
          copyText(reportText, 'Report Ticket Text');

          const newReport = {
            id: 'REPORT-' + Date.now(),
            gamertag,
            platform,
            description,
            proof,
            date: new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
            status: 'Pending Discord Submission'
          };

          try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem('ghostmc_admin_reports');
            const reports = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
            reports.push(newReport);
            localStorage.setItem('ghostmc_admin_reports', JSON.stringify(reports));
          } catch (err) {
            console.warn('LocalStorage error');
          }

          adminComplaintForm.reset();
          closeReportModal();
          showToast('📋 Report Copied!', 'Ticket text copied! Opening Discord in new tab...', true);
          window.open('https://discord.gg/f9cETGR27b', '_blank');
        });
      }


      // Photo Gallery Lightbox Logic
      const galleryData = [
        {
          src: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,',
          title: 'Central Hub & Nether Portal Sword',
          desc: 'Main server spawn pavilion with floating holograms, Netherite sword monument, and cherry trees.'
        },
        {
          src: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,',
          title: 'Sunset Island Aerial Overview',
          desc: 'Sunset view of spawn island, featuring purpur village roofs, parkour lanes, and blossoming orchards.'
        },
        {
          src: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,',
          title: 'Night Sky Beacon & Sword Monument',
          desc: 'Atmospheric night scene of the crimson beacon beam piercing into the starry sky above spawn.'
        }
      ];

      let currentPhotoIndex = 0;
      const photoLightboxModal = document.getElementById('photoLightboxModal');
      const lightboxImg = document.getElementById('lightboxImg');
      const lightboxTitle = document.getElementById('lightboxTitle');
      const lightboxDesc = document.getElementById('lightboxDesc');
      const lightboxCounter = document.getElementById('lightboxCounter');
      const closeLightboxBtn = document.getElementById('closeLightboxBtn');
      const lightboxPrevBtn = document.getElementById('lightboxPrevBtn');
      const lightboxNextBtn = document.getElementById('lightboxNextBtn');

      function openLightbox(index) {
        currentPhotoIndex = (index + galleryData.length) % galleryData.length;
        const item = galleryData[currentPhotoIndex];
        if (lightboxImg && item) {
          lightboxImg.src = item.src;
          if (lightboxTitle) lightboxTitle.textContent = item.title;
          if (lightboxDesc) lightboxDesc.textContent = item.desc;
          if (lightboxCounter) lightboxCounter.textContent = `${currentPhotoIndex + 1} / ${galleryData.length}`;
        }
        if (photoLightboxModal) photoLightboxModal.classList.remove('hidden');
      }

      function closeLightbox() {
        if (photoLightboxModal) photoLightboxModal.classList.add('hidden');
      }

      document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-card, .view-photo-btn').forEach(el => {
        el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          const idx = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-index') || '0', 10);
          openLightbox(idx);
        });
      });

      if (closeLightboxBtn) closeLightboxBtn.addEventListener('click', closeLightbox);
      if (lightboxPrevBtn) lightboxPrevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => openLightbox(currentPhotoIndex - 1));
      if (lightboxNextBtn) lightboxNextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => openLightbox(currentPhotoIndex + 1));

      if (photoLightboxModal) {
        photoLightboxModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          if (e.target === photoLightboxModal) closeLightbox();
        });
      }

      document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (!photoLightboxModal || photoLightboxModal.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
        if (e.key === 'Escape') closeLightbox();
        if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') openLightbox(currentPhotoIndex - 1);
        if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') openLightbox(currentPhotoIndex + 1);
      });

    });
  </script>
  <!-- ================= PHOTO LIGHTBOX MODAL ================= -->
  <div id="photoLightboxModal" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 hidden bg-black/95 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6">
    <div class="relative max-w-5xl w-full flex flex-col items-center">
      <!-- Close button -->
      <button id="closeLightboxBtn" type="button" class="absolute -top-12 right-0 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white p-2 rounded-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-700 transition-colors" aria-label="Close Lightbox">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark text-lg"></i>
      </button>

      <!-- Main Image Container -->
      <div class="relative w-full rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-neutral-700 shadow-2xl bg-neutral-950 flex items-center justify-center">
        <img id="lightboxImg" src="" alt="GhostMC SMP Screenshot Fullscreen" class="w-full max-h-[75vh] object-contain mx-auto">
        
        <!-- Prev / Next Controls -->
        <button id="lightboxPrevBtn" type="button" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-11 h-11 rounded-full bg-neutral-900/80 hover:bg-cyan-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center border border-neutral-700 transition-all shadow-lg active:scale-95" aria-label="Previous photo">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-left text-base"></i>
        </button>
        <button id="lightboxNextBtn" type="button" class="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-11 h-11 rounded-full bg-neutral-900/80 hover:bg-cyan-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center border border-neutral-700 transition-all shadow-lg active:scale-95" aria-label="Next photo">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right text-base"></i>
        </button>
      </div>

      <!-- Caption & Counter -->
      <div class="w-full mt-3 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-neutral-300 px-2">
        <div class="text-left">
          <div id="lightboxTitle" class="font-bold text-white text-sm sm:text-base">GhostMC SMP Snapshot</div>
          <div id="lightboxDesc" class="text-neutral-400 text-xs mt-0.5">Official Season 1 In-Game Photo</div>
        </div>
        <div id="lightboxCounter" class="font-mono text-cyan-400 font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800">1 / 3</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</body>
</html>
